run_extract_lora_from_model: run the script to extract a LoRA checkpoint from a fully finetuned CogVideoX model using base and finetuned checkpoint paths
extract_lora_function: extract LoRA weights from a weight difference tensor using SVD decomposition with configurable rank
parse_args_cli: parse command line arguments for base checkpoint path, finetuned checkpoint path, rank, and output safetensors path
main_extract_and_save: load base and finetuned CogVideoX models, compute weight differences, extract LoRA, and save to safetensors
review_extract_lora: review the extract_lora function that performs SVD on weight differences and clamps singular values using quantile
